rules.statement: The cause of action survives against the surviving partners where one partner dies before the institution of a suit.
rules.supporting_quote: "In the instant case the cause of action is based on a contract of tenancy between the plaintiff and the three partners of the firm of W. Lalchand & Co. The obligations on the contract are joint and accordingly the liability to be sued on the death of one of the partners survives."

meta.parties: The Mahakande Housing Company Ltd. v. Duhilamomal and Others
